paper_level_summary_zh: 本文在相关工作部分引用 [23] 'Lidarphone'，将其归类为一种激光麦克风方法，并指其属于侵入式攻击，需在受害者设备上安装恶意软件以提取激光数据。该引用属于普通相关工作总结，未对其技术能力进行确认或评价。

evidences.evidence_quote: Laser microphones[20], [21], [22], [23], [34] use lidar sensors to illuminate vibrating objects and collect reflected signals for audio reconstruction.
evidences.evidence_context: Laser microphones[20], [21], [22], [23], [34] use lidar sensors to illuminate vibrating objects and collect reflected signals for audio reconstruction. However, these methods have several drawbacks: ... Certain methods[22], [23] are considered intrusive attacks, requiring malware installation in the victim’s device to extract laser data.
evidences.reference_entry: S. Sami, S. R. X. Tan, Y. Dai, N. Roy, and J. Han, “Lidarphone: Acoustic eavesdropping using a LiDAR sensor,” in Proc. 18th Conf. Embedded Networked Sensor Syst., 2020, pp. 701–702.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引文 [23] 实际对应的是论文 'Lidarphone: Acoustic eavesdropping using a LiDAR sensor'，该论文是一篇关于使用LiDAR传感器进行声学窃听的短文，而非目标论文 'Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping on Loudspeakers via RFID by Capturing Sub-mm Level Vibration'。因此这是一次误引用（false positive），应排除。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 引用论文将 [23] 误归为激光麦克风方法，但实际 [23] 是Lidarphone论文，并非目标RFID窃听论文。
